subject: Security crosswalk & sprint plan for evaluation — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention
messages:
From: Oliver James <oliver.james@oldshore.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: security gates we need for eval / timeline

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. Oldshore wants to make sure the security/compliance gates are explicit in the MAP before we lock dates. Can you confirm:

- When we can expect a SOC 2 Type II report summary and the scope (production vs staging)?
- A completed SIG/CAIQ or answers spreadsheet — roughly how long to produce?
- DPA redline turnaround and whether Redwood accepts the EU residency clause we flagged.
- What you recommend for a retention window for our PII (Oldshore preference: 3 years unless otherwise agreed).

We have a target decision week of June 30 — ideally a mutual plan so our procurement and legal teams can track.

Attachments: none (I referenced our internal procurement checklist).

—Oliver
Oliver James
Procurement Lead, Oldshore Financial
oliver.james@oldshore.com
+1 415 555 0123

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver James <oliver.james@oldshore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: security gates we need for eval / timeline

Oliver —

Appreciate the clear list. I put together a short crosswalk + sprint plan we can use as the MAP appendix (attached: Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx). High level answers here so your team can start lining up reviewers: 

1) SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary covering our hosted inference platform (production) by 2025-06-20. Full report review under NDA; summary includes in-scope systems, control areas, and testing periods.

2) SIG/CAIQ: we maintain an up-to-date CAIQ and can export an answered spreadsheet. Expect a first-pass export by 2025-06-18, final within 3 business days after your follow-up questions.

3) DPA: we have a standard DPA and can provide a redline back within 3 business days of receiving yours. For the EU residency clause you flagged, legal is generally amenable to limited residency carveouts for regulated accounts under Dedicated/Private deployment — Iren e will confirm minimal language.

4) Data retention: default is 2 years for customer content in hosted deployments (configurable). For Oldshore’s 3-year ask, we can support via contract amendment; retention tiers and archival pricing are in tab 2 of the MAP draft.

Proposed MAP sprint (short):
- 2025-06-12: MAP acceptance & reviewers assigned (you)
- 2025-06-18: CAIQ export delivered (us)
- 2025-06-20: SOC 2 summary delivered (us)
- 2025-06-21: DPA redline returned (us)
- 2025-06-23: Legal & procurement sync (joint call)
- 2025-06-30: Decision week / signoff target

Next steps: I’ll loop in Legal for the DPA carveouts and Karthik for any technical evidence owners. If the dates above look okay, I’ll drop a DocuSign link for the MAP appendix and a Calendly for the 6/23 sync.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP appendix, timelines & ownership).

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650 555 0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Oliver James <oliver.james@oldshore.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: security gates we need for eval / timeline

Oliver / Tessa —

Quick tech notes to set expectations on evidence and delivery cadence: 

- SOC 2 summary: the summary we provide will include control coverage (CC & TSC mapping), testing period (Jan–Jun 2025), and any open remediation items. If Oldshore needs system-level logs for a deep audit, we can provide guidance on the evidence package but that requires an access plan (shared sandbox).

- CAIQ: our CAIQ export includes control statements and references to artifacts. Typical gaps customers ask about are around RBAC implementation details and long-term access logging. If you can flag the top 5 controls you want evidence for, we’ll prioritize artifact pulls.

- Retention: implementing 3-year retention for customer content on hosted requires an archival configuration and slight pricing delta; Dedicated/Private gives you more control over retention by default.

Irene — I’ll let you weigh in on acceptable DPA language for the EU residency ask (we usually propose: data residency controls + carveout for Dedicated deployments).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Manager, Security & Compliance

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Oliver James <oliver.james@oldshore.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: security gates we need for eval / timeline

Oliver / team —

Thanks — a few legal points to keep the MAP tidy and make procurement easier: 

- DPA redline turnaround: once we receive Oldshore’s redline we aim to respond within 3 business days. For any proposed EU residency mandatory hosting clause, we will include two options in our response: (A) Dedicated/Private deployment with EU residency guarantee and associated uplift, or (B) Hosted offering + contractual controls and encryption assurances (no hard residency).

- Retention clause: we can accept a 3-year retention requirement for customer PII in hosted if Oldshore agrees to the archival pricing and a clearly scoped deletion/return process at termination. Suggested language: "Customer Data will be retained for no longer than 3 years from ingestion unless otherwise required by law; Redwood will provide a documented export and deletion plan within 30 days of termination."

- SOC 2 & evidence: to expedite access to redacted evidence for your security reviewers, please sign the mutual NDA (I attached our standard NDA link in the MAP). We will not share full control testing artifacts without an executed mutual NDA.

Attachments: DPA-redline-proposal.docx (legal’s starter redline), SOC2-snapshot-summary.pdf (redacted).

I’ll join the 6/23 sync and lead the DPA section.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Security & Privacy, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
